response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software engineer with a strong background in full-stack web development, Node.js, TypeScript, and DLang, but he lacks the mandatory core requirements for this position. He does not have the required 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development experience on Windows, having only 7 months of professional C++ experience from nearly a decade ago. Furthermore, he lacks the deep Capital Markets or Fixed Income domain expertise needed for this specific role.
strengths: Over 15 years of professional software engineering experience across various modern tech stacks.
Strong background in CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and software craftsmanship methodologies like TDD.
Brief exposure to investment platforms and financial tech from his tenure at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Falls significantly short of the mandatory 5-10 years of hands-on C++ experience.
Lacks demonstrated C++ development experience specifically on the Windows platform.
Missing the required deep Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain expertise.
